BiblicalUsage: Ezbai is named only once, as the father of Naarai, one of David's mighty men in 1 Chronicles 11:37. The verse gives us nothing else about him — no deed, no speech, no story of his own. His name survives because his son stood among the men who fought beside David.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps the names of the faithful even when their stories are lost to us. Ezbai matters because his son is counted among David's men, and that is enough for Scripture to remember him.
